1.explanation: Both prism-sql.js and its minified counterpart define the SQL grammar in Prism, including the regex for string tokens. The existing pattern only matches single and double quotes, so backtick-quoted identifiers slip through unhighlighted. Updating the 'string' definition in these files to include backticks (as shown in the bug report) fixes the highlighting for MySQL style identifiers.

The expected behavior is that backtick-quoted identifiers should be tokenized by the string pattern and styled accordingly.
